title: Values within a segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers whose entries are the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$. For every index $i$ less than the length of $l$, the value $\mu(a+i)$ equals the $i$th entry of $l$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $l$ equal the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$
